pages.title: Caribou
pages.text: The caribou ($(o)Rangifer tarandus$()), known as the reindeer in Eurasia, is a deer of the Arctic tundra and boreal forests of North America, Europe and Asia.$(br2)It is the only deer in which both males and females regularly grow antlers.$(br2)Some caribou herds make the longest overland migrations of any land mammal, and in winter they survive largely on lichens dug out from beneath the snow.
